stories.title: Belted Galloways back on Moel Famau to graze moorland for rare birds
stories.summary: Cattle are back on Moel Famau, grazing an enclosure set aside to help protect black grouse. The Belted Galloways have returned to the hill as part of a conservation grazing scheme run by Natural Resources Wales and the Clwydian Range and Dee Valley National Landscape.
